# FlattenOnce

Flattens one level of nesting in an array of arrays.

## Signature

```jyro
# fragment
FlattenOnce(items)
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | array | The array to flatten, which is left unchanged. Null is read as the empty array; any other type that is not an array is a runtime error. |

## Returns

Array. A new array in which each element of items that is an array is replaced by its own elements, which are kept as they are even when they are arrays, and every other element, null included, is kept as it is, all in order. Never null.

## Example

`FlattenOnce([1, [2, [3]]])` returns `[1, 2, [3]]`.
